entities.summary: Suresh Wadkar (b. 1954-08-07, Kolhapur) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kolhapur and India. Known in the fields of india, composers & musicians, asia.
